feature_description: The root-level www/ directory is a committed, stale snapshot of the deployed CCU web root (Tcl CGIs, ReGa pages, JSON-RPC API, webui.js bundle, vendored JS/CSS, device images; 4,051 tracked entries incl. 24 dangling absolute symlinks). The shipped web root is produced by the CMake targets webui-assets and webui-www-source-assets (from src/webui/www and src/webui/rega/www) plus devicetypes-assets (st_values.cgi/js from src/devicetypes); www/ is only written by the manual 'make deploy' path and is read by no build, CI or test step.

control_flows.summary: Staged web root assembly: copy src/webui/www and src/webui/rega/www into ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www and create the runtime symlinks
control_flows.migration_impact: One of three producers of the shipped web root (with CF002 and CF007); its output must remain byte-identical after www/ is removed and is part of the manifest baseline for the before/after sha256 comparison.

control_flows.summary: Generation of webui.js, style.css and DEVDB.tcl from www_source, re-encoding to ISO-8859-1 and copying into the staged web root, then deleting the generator outputs
control_flows.migration_impact: Replaces the tracked generated copies www/webui/webui.js, www/webui/style.css and www/config/devdescr/DEVDB.tcl; line structure and encoding must stay unchanged because OpenCCU rootfs patches target them.

control_flows.summary: make deploy: build and install a platform, then copy selected-install etc/firmware/www/opt/usr back into the repo tree
control_flows.migration_impact: The only in-repo writer of ./www; must be changed to skip www (or redirect to build/) before www/ is deleted, otherwise it silently recreates the tree.

control_flows.summary: CI staged-package verification: build with DEPLOY_TO_REPO=OFF and assert staged webui.js, style.css and DEVDB.tcl are non-empty
control_flows.migration_impact: Already checks the generated staged copies, not the committed ones, so deleting www/ does not affect it; a new guard step against tracked www/ files and a manifest comparison are added here.

control_flows.summary: Install closure of the assets component: install ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www/ to www
control_flows.migration_impact: Consumes the staging tree, not the repo www/; unaffected by removal. tests/test-components.py only creates a temporary www/keep placeholder inside a temp rootfs.

control_flows.summary: Sibling OpenCCU Buildroot build: pin this repo by SHA, build the web root via src/webui, apply rootfs patches to the staged asset-rootfs and copy www into the target
control_flows.migration_impact: Does not read repo www/; after cutover its OPENCCU_BASE_VERSION pin must be bumped and make check-openccu-base plus patch validation re-run.

control_flows.summary: devicetypes-assets copies st_values.cgi and st_values.js into the staged www/config, forced on whenever BUILD_WEBUI is ON
control_flows.migration_impact: Third producer of the staged web root; the before/after manifest must cover it so st_values.* are accounted for when repo www/ is removed.

external_systems.name: OpenCCU Buildroot packaging repo
external_systems.description: Pins this repo by SHA, builds the web root through src/webui, applies 64 rootfs patches (41 on webui.js) to the staged asset-rootfs.
external_systems.error_contract: Patch application fails the Buildroot build if the generated webui.js changes shape.

external_systems.name: GitHub Actions CI
external_systems.description: Builds 4 platforms with -DDEPLOY_TO_REPO=OFF and verifies the staged package.
external_systems.error_contract: Job fails if a staged artifact is empty or missing.

external_systems.name: CMake with Tcl and Python
external_systems.description: CMake 3.20+ presets, tclsh for create_*.tcl generators and python3 for utf82ansi.py.

external_systems.name: CCU runtime paths
external_systems.description: /opt/hm/www, /etc/config/addons/www, /var/EULA.* and /tmp/EULA.* targets of the web root symlinks.
external_systems.purpose: Link shared Tcl libraries and EULA files into the served tree
external_systems.error_contract: Committed absolute links dangle outside a device; CMake creates relative or /tmp targets in the staged tree.

external_systems.name: ReGaHss (closed source)
external_systems.description: Serves /rega and evaluates <% %> pages from the installed /www/rega; its binary references /licenseinfo.htm.
external_systems.purpose: Home automation logic engine consuming the staged web root
external_systems.error_contract: Missing rega pages or licenseinfo.htm are served as errors; not controlled by this repo.

user_stories.goal: Build the shipped web root exclusively from src/webui sources, never from the committed www/
requirements: GIVEN the webui-assets target WHEN it runs THEN src/webui/www is copied into ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www and src/webui/rega/www into ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www/rega
GIVEN the target WHEN it runs THEN it never references the repository-level www/ directory
GIVEN webui-assets WHEN it runs THEN it depends on webui-www-source-assets and webui-scripts-assets
GIVEN src/webui/www or src/webui/rega/www is missing WHEN webui-assets runs THEN copy_directory fails and the build step aborts without producing a staged web root
edge_cases: Repo www/ has 30 entries absent from src/webui/www: 24 symlinks plus DEVDB.tcl, st_values.cgi, st_values.js, style.css, webui.js and rega/licenseinfo.htm; the staged root gets them only via CMake link creation, generators or devicetypes-assets (SP009)
copy_directory overwrites existing staged files; src/webui/www has no rega/ folder, so rega/www adds files without overlap

user_stories.goal: Generate webui.js, style.css and DEVDB.tcl at build time and stage them in ISO-8859-1
requirements: GIVEN the target WHEN it runs THEN create_webui_js.tcl, create_style_css.tcl and create_devdb_tcl.tcl are executed in www_source
GIVEN each generated file WHEN produced THEN utf82ansi.py converts it before copy_if_different into ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www/webui or www/config/devdescr
GIVEN the copies are done WHEN the target ends THEN generator outputs and tmp files are deleted from the source tree
GIVEN tclsh or python3 is unavailable or a create_*.tcl generator exits non-zero WHEN webui-www-source-assets runs THEN the target fails and no file is copied into the staged web root
edge_cases: st_values.js and devicetypes outputs are staged by devicetypes-assets (SP009), not by this target; www_source only removes its own intermediate copy
The generated www/webui/webui.js is 1.9 MB, 53,123 lines, ISO-8859-1, and sibling patches depend on its exact line structure

user_stories.goal: Create runtime symlinks in the staged web root with relative or /tmp targets
requirements: GIVEN the staged tree WHEN assets are built THEN www/cgi.tcl, common.tcl, once.tcl, session.tcl, user.tcl link into tcl/extern or tcl/eq3_old
GIVEN api/pda subtrees WHEN built THEN eq3/rega.tcl and eq3/session.tcl link to ../../tcl/eq3/*
GIVEN rega EULA files WHEN built THEN www/rega/EULA.de and EULA.en link to /tmp/EULA.de and /tmp/EULA.en and www/addons links to /etc/config/addons/www
GIVEN a link name already exists as a directory or a parent directory is missing WHEN create_symlink runs THEN the command fails and webui-assets aborts
edge_cases: Committed www/ links instead point to absolute /opt/hm/www/... and /var/EULA.* and dangle in every checkout and on Windows
Re-running create_symlink over an existing link in the staged tree is idempotent
Committed www/addons points to /opt/hm/etc/config/addons/www while CMake links www/addons to /etc/config/addons/www

output_shape.symlinks: 24 links (addons, 5 root, 8 config, 4 tools, 4 api/pda, 2 EULA)

user_stories.goal: Install the staged web root as the assets component
requirements: GIVEN a build WHEN the assets component is installed THEN ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www/ is installed to www
GIVEN tests/test-components.py WHEN it builds a temp rootfs THEN it creates www/keep inside that temp rootfs, not in the repository www/
GIVEN ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www/ does not exist WHEN the assets component is installed THEN install(DIRECTORY) fails, which is why tests/test-components.py creates www/keep
edge_cases: An empty staged www/ still installs (the test relies on a keep placeholder)
The install reads the staging tree, so deleting repo www/ does not change installed content

user_stories.goal: Persist generated web root assets in the repository only through the deploy path, which has drifted
requirements: GIVEN make deploy-<platform> WHEN run THEN selected-install etc, firmware, www, opt and usr are copied with cp -a into ./etc ./firmware ./www ./opt ./usr
GIVEN deploy WHEN run THEN bin and lib are copied into bin/<platform> and lib/<platform>
GIVEN no one runs make deploy WHEN sources change THEN repo www/ is not updated and drifts (90 files differ from src/webui/www, 49 from src/webui/rega/www)
edge_cases: Nonexistent $rootfs_dir/www is skipped silently by the [ -d ] test
cp -a of the staged tree writes generated webui.js, style.css and DEVDB.tcl into tracked www/ paths
Commit 1ba5c642 deleted incompatiblebrowser.html in both www/ and src/webui/www (and debug.htm from src/webui/rega/www), showing that edits have to be made twice

output_shape.repo dirs: bin/<platform>, lib/<platform>, etc, firmware, www, opt, usr overwritten

user_stories.goal: Keep generated outputs out of version control
requirements: GIVEN DEVDB.tcl, devdescr.js, resource.js, st_values.js, style.css or webui.js in www_source WHEN git status runs THEN they are ignored
GIVEN www/config/devdescr/.gitignore WHEN present THEN it ignores everything except itself, yet DEVDB.tcl is tracked under www/
edge_cases: Files added before the ignore rule stay tracked (www/webui/webui.js, www/webui/style.css, DEVDB.tcl, st_values.js); www/rega/licenseinfo.htm is tracked but is not produced by any in-repo build (ReGaHss references /licenseinfo.htm and the sibling regenerates it), so it is a stale artifact, not a generator output
No automated guard prevents re-adding a second web root copy

user_stories.goal: Verify the staged package output in CI without reading repository www/
requirements: GIVEN a platform build with DEPLOY_TO_REPO=OFF WHEN verification runs THEN test -s passes for stage www/webui/webui.js, www/webui/style.css and www/config/devdescr/DEVDB.tcl
GIVEN any of these staged files is empty or missing WHEN verification runs THEN the step fails
GIVEN tracked files exist under repo www/ WHEN CI runs THEN no step currently fails (no guard exists)
edge_cases: Platform matrix of 4 builds; BINARY_FORMAT grep applies only to bin/rfd and lib/tclrega.so
The check validates generated staged copies, not the committed ones, so it passes with or without repo www/

user_stories.goal: Document the repository layout, currently describing www/ as WebUI resources
requirements: GIVEN README.md WHEN a contributor reads the layout THEN www/ is described as 'WebUI and Tcl-based runtime resources'
GIVEN the README WHEN read THEN it does not state that src/webui is the only source or that make deploy writes www/
edge_cases: The sole documentation reference to www/ in the repository; no CONTRIBUTING guidance on the double-edit trap
cmake/README.md:33 and :100 also document make deploy and are in the plan scope

user_stories.goal: Stage st_values.cgi and st_values.js into the web root from src/devicetypes
requirements: GIVEN the devicetypes-assets target WHEN it runs THEN src/devicetypes/st_values.cgi and st_values.js are copied with copy_if_different into ${ROOTFS_DIR}/www/config
GIVEN BUILD_WEBUI is ON WHEN cmake/Components.cmake configures THEN BUILD_DEVICETYPES is forced ON so these files are staged
GIVEN a source file is missing WHEN copy_if_different runs THEN the target fails
edge_cases: The tracked www/config/st_values.* copies are identical to the src/devicetypes sources, so they are plain sources, not generated outputs
The www_source target also deletes a generated st_values.js in www_source; that is unrelated to this copy
The sibling stage_validation_rootfs.sh builds devicetypes-assets too

nfrs.requirement: The staged web root generated by webui-assets, webui-www-source-assets and devicetypes-assets must remain file-for-file and byte-for-byte identical, excluding already merged source changes; webui.js line structure and ISO-8859-1 encoding are relied on by 41 sibling patches.
nfrs.verification: Record file list, sha256 sums and symlink targets of the staged tree before and after the cutover and diff them.

nfrs.requirement: tcl/eq3/rega.tcl is staged as a plain copy; the sibling prepare_patch_input.sh deliberately strips CRLF from the staged copy, so no CRLF contract is imposed on this repo by sibling patches.
nfrs.verification: Diff the staged rega.tcl before and after cutover (must be identical) and run the sibling patch validation.

nfrs.requirement: Committed symlinks use absolute targets (/opt/hm/www/..., /var/EULA.*), which dangle in checkouts and break on Windows; the staged tree must use relative or /tmp targets.
nfrs.verification: git ls-files -s www | awk '$1==120000' plus readlink; compare with staged symlink targets.

nfrs.requirement: Security findings (default admin credentials in tcl/eq3_old/user.tcl:8-9, cp_software.cgi:493 request-driven exec, homematic.cgi:155 errorInfo leak) exist identically in www/ and src/webui/www; removal of www/ only removes duplicates.
nfrs.verification: Re-run static analysis on src/webui/www after removal; findings must remain tracked in the webui-* features.

nfrs.requirement: Repository weight: 49 MB working copy and 511 MiB pack, roughly 3,000 files duplicated verbatim; history is not rewritten.
nfrs.source: Repository root (git count-objects -vH, git ls-files www)
nfrs.verification: Compare git ls-files count and du of the working tree before and after.

evidence_gaps: Whether third-party packagers or forks consume repo www/ (GitHub raw paths, archives) cannot be proven from the repositories; resolved by the Phase 0 maintainer check in the cutover plan.

The 90 differing files (52 outside config, 38 in config plus 11 only in www/config) and 49 rega differences were counted but not reviewed one by one for www/-only hot-fixes; resolved by the triage step in SDD specify/tasks.
The sibling repo (/home/standard/dev/OpenCCU) was not re-read during analysis; its consumption of src/webui rather than www/ is taken from the plan's verified evidence.
Whether tests or tooling in forks still invoke make deploy with the web root expected in ./www is unknown.
licenseinfo.htm is regenerated by the sibling (openccu-base.mk:210-212) per audit; the cutover plan should record that no in-repo producer exists.
